common.selection: t00 family, shutdown/context_reset, all statuses/target slots, unfinished task, remaining=2, simple/chronological/reverse variants and both roles.
common.scope_limit: 12 independent generated identity cases, 36 notice variants, 72 role observations. One authored hard wording family. Higher revision time changes the subject; both text orders are tested within each case.

field_reference.purpose: Primary canonical role contrast; all direct and contrast variants reported.

explicit_identity.purpose: Required strong explicit-ID semantic-mean baseline and all corresponding role contrasts.

required_reporting: Independent raw-score audit plus matched and history-order tables, complete-case correctness, frequency/first/last-candidate controls and a grammar-aware ceiling. The t01 wording family remains unqueried by this first slice.
